review: home layout B 'Quiet Home', round 2, LOOK lens (independent reviewer)
summary: The round-1 medium (L1) is fixed. At 667x375, and at 1024x768, Marumi now shows her still portrait (live.why 'fit', no canvas), 8 px clear of every control (artClearance 0 fails). Where her living scene runs (740x360 at 90 %, 844x390, 915x412, 1280x720 and 1920x1080 at 88-100 %), it also passes with 0 fails. Six of the nine round-1 lows are fixed: L2 (FREE sticker inside RECRUIT's cell), L3 (dock cells sized to their labels), L4 (one-line BOSSES kicker), L6 (no navy dip on a return), L8 (the dock starts at the 16 px gutter) and L10 (SNT-HQ at 5.7:1 or more over every bright full illustration). L9 is mostly fixed: Social and Settings now sit at the bottom of the tablet sheet. Full illustrations are drawn whole, never zoomed: zoom 1 at the cover fit and only panned. That holds for all 11 pictures at all 8 sizes (88 of 88). Her face core is on screen and clear of every control in all 88 cases. In 4 of the 88, the picture puts her head near its top edge and the top bar passes over the top of her hair (390x844: rampart, kinu, marumi-scene; 667x375: rampart). The face stays clear by a wide margin, so this reads acceptably. Hearts on a tap are back (stand: 3 on the head, 1 on the body; full illustrations: 3 and 1, never a bubble). Stepped and real-time recordings show the first entrance done about 640 ms after the reveal. The return is done by about 320 ms, and its wallpaper never fades from 0. Reduce Motion is 120 ms fades only. e2e/home.mjs at 844x390, 390x844 and 667x375 (rampart and small) gives 126 ok, 0 fail. Remaining are lows only: two carried from round 1 (L5 plates over full illustrations, owner trade-off; L7 day-style picker, predates) and five new low notes, two of which predate this branch.
environment_note: 4 CPUs, load 1.4-10 from other agents. SwiftShader WebGL, headless Chromium 153 (Playwright from /opt/node22, browsers in /opt/pw-browsers). Real-time video and CDP screencast drop frames during transitions, so the entrance was also recorded stepped. For that, every document animation (the home's CSS pieces plus the transition's WAAPI cut, wipe and screen fade) was paused at the reveal or at the return's mount and stepped by currentTime. The lobby's .static class was held off while stepping. An rAF sampler of the pieces' effective opacity checks the real-time timing. One 1920x1080 run of the extras (Halloween, fresh and max saves) timed out on a screenshot; those cases were covered at 390x844, 667x375, 844x390 and 1024x768, and the 1920 main shots all completed.

findings.title: (carried) Full illustrations: the Battle plate, CO-OP tab and chip still sit over her body on 4:3 and small screens
findings.detail: The owner-chosen trade-off from round 1 is unchanged. With the corners locked and the picture now never zoomed, Hikari's rampart at 1024x768 has the plate and CO-OP tab over her skirt and scabbard, and the news chip beside her hair. At 667x375 the plate sits over her waist. Her face core is clear in every case. At 844x390, 1280x720 and 1920x1080 the plate mostly falls on the background (yuzuha, kinu). No change asked unless the owner wants a slimmer plate on full illustrations.

findings.title: (carried, predates this branch) The background picker is still the white day-style modal; its bond lock line reads 'Date her'
findings.detail: The Background tool in the menu head still opens the white Academy modal. Its smallest text is 8.64 px at 667x375 and 844x390 (9.6 px at 390x844 and 1024x768), and it has yellow fills (Secretary, DONE), which clash with the night home. A content note in the same modal: the lock line for a bond-locked full illustration reads 'Date her & give gifts in the City' (src/ui/lobby/bgPicker.js:132, on main since the skins work). It names a game mechanic, but on a student's tile it reads as romantic framing, against the rule that Sensei is a friendly teacher, never romantic. Suggest 'Spend time with her & give gifts in the City' when the menus build restyles this modal. bgPicker.js is not in this branch's diff.

findings.title: Portrait phone: the top bar's wallet row passes over the top of her hair on three full illustrations (reads acceptably)
findings.detail: At 390x844, Hikari's rampart (wide picture, cover 1512x844), Kinu's and Marumi's 3:4 full art have her head near the picture's top edge. placeFull reports clearCtl false, and the hair box meets the avatar, chat and mail row; the wallet pills sit across her crown, halo or ribbon. Her face core (eyes, mouth, glasses) is fully clear, about 40 px below the pills, and the hair stays readable around them. The same happens at 667x375 on the rampart, where the gems pill touches the crown of her head. Every other case (84 of 88) keeps her hair clear too. Judged acceptable: it reads like a portrait framed behind a status bar, not a cut face. Optional polish: a soft top scrim behind the wallet row on portrait, so the pills sit on ink rather than on her hair.

findings.title: 1920x1080: the home's chrome keeps its 1280 size, so it reads small and far apart
findings.detail: At 1920x1080 the controls are the same pixel size as at 1280x720: 13 px dock caps, a 320 px news chip and a 330 px plate. The four corners sit about 1,900 px apart around a large picture. Everything is legible and nothing overlaps, but the chrome feels undersized on a full-HD desktop. An optional scale step at 1600 px and wider (for example 1.15-1.25x on the bar, chip, dock and plate) would balance it.

findings.title: (content, predates this branch) 'Summer Breeze' puts the adult hero's bust at the centre of the landscape home
findings.detail: Yoriko is an adult hero. Her full illustration (the owner's own picture, byte for byte, on main since v0.1.48) has a low-cut sundress. On landscape screens the cover fit puts her face in the top third and her chest in the middle of the screen: 740x360, 844x390 and 1920x1080, where only about 36 px of the top and 200 px of the bottom are cropped. This branch changes nothing about the picture, and the no-zoom rule means its framing is the painting's own. Flagged only so the owner can weigh it against the §6 rule that adult heroes are never framed around their bodies. Their call; not blocking.

findings.title: Folded 2x2 dock (667x375, 740x360, 1024x768): the COMMISSIONS caps nearly fill their 64 px cell
findings.detail: The one-row dock now sizes its cells to their labels, with 9 px either side (L3 fixed). In the folded 2x2 block, though, the cells stay a fixed 64 px. COMMISSIONS (60.6 px of caps) sits 1.7 px from its cell edges and about 4 px from the column hairline, while STUDENTS, RECRUIT and MALL have 9-20 px. That is the round-1 rhythm issue again, in the fold only, and minor. Size the folded columns to the widest label, or drop the hairline in the fold.

findings.title: (predates; until the menus go night) A return from a day-style screen passes through the pale day background
findings.detail: Stepping the return from Missions: the Missions screen (still day style) fades out, the navy ink wipe crosses the pale day background of #app, and the home fades in over that pale ground. At +40 ms the home is a washed, light frame; it is full by +80 ms. It is not a navy dip, and the wallpaper no longer fades from 0 (L6 fixed). In real time this is one or two frames of a light flash into a night screen. It will go away once the sub-screens wear the night kit (another session's menus build).
